item.title: Usage Approval: What to Allow and on What Basis
item.description:
Where this page fits

This is the step where you decide whether to actually use open source that has gone through identification and issue resolution. Approval should not rest on one person’s judgment; it should follow a defined procedure and leave records. This is the third procedure of the FSEC guide, and it connects to license obligation review (3.1.5) and governance in ISO/IEC 5230.

Documents produced here: approval request, review, and decision records, and open source requirement clauses for outsourcing contracts.
